selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: How does the passage say the attribute of Speech makes Allah known?
questions.answer: It makes Him known through revelation and inspiration.

questions.question: How is the attribute of Power described as speaking without words?
questions.answer: Its created works function like visible messages that show who their Maker is.

questions.question: How does the passage distinguish between Speech and Power?
questions.answer: Speech makes Allah known through communicated guidance, while Power makes Him known through created effects.

questions.question: Through what kinds of created things does the attribute of Knowledge make Allah known?
questions.answer: Through created things that are wise, orderly, balanced, directed, decorated, and clearly distinguished.

questions.question: How do the signs of other attributes support the truth of Life?
questions.answer: Since power with purpose, knowledge, hearing, sight, will, and speech belong to the living, they all point back to Life.

questions.question: What is the connection between Life and the constant variety in the world?
questions.answer: Life is said to drive the ongoing renewal that brings out fresh forms and patterns.

questions.question: What image is used to describe the universe after this renewal?
questions.answer: It is pictured as a great mirror made up of countless smaller mirrors.

questions.question: What logical link does the passage make between Will and Life?
questions.answer: It says choosing and intending can only belong to one who is alive.

questions.question: What can be inferred from the claim that Life has proofs more numerous than the cosmos?
questions.answer: Its evidence is overwhelming and appears throughout all creation.

questions.question: What are the two main ways mentioned in the passage by which Allah is made known?
questions.answer: He is made known through revelation and inspiration on one side, and through creation and its signs on the other.

questions.question: What reveals Allah through the created world?
questions.answer: The attribute of Power reveals Him through the works and effects seen in creation.

questions.question: What does the passage say those visible effects do?
questions.answer: They describe and point to a glorious and powerful Creator.

questions.question: Besides its own direct evidence, what other support does Life receive?
questions.answer: It is backed by the signs of Power, Knowledge, and the rest of the Divine attributes.

questions.question: What two kinds of proof are given for Life?
questions.answer: Proofs that belong directly to Life itself and proofs borrowed from all the other attributes.

questions.question: Why are animate beings especially important in this proof?
questions.answer: Because they display living signs directly and reflect many other Divine qualities.

questions.question: What is the relationship between Seeing, Hearing, Will, and Speech and the Most Sacred Essence?
questions.answer: Each of these attributes reveals and makes the Essence known.

questions.question: How are Seeing and Hearing treated in relation to Allah’s Essence?
questions.answer: They are among the attributes that make the Essence known.

questions.question: How does the passage argue that seeing and hearing imply life?
questions.answer: It treats them as qualities that belong only to one who is alive.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the attribute of Speech?
questions.answer: It teaches that Speech makes Allah known by means of revelation and inspiration.

questions.question: What is the first comparison made about Power in this passage?
questions.answer: It is linked with crafted works in creation that point to Allah.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does the whole universe resemble when viewed through Power?
questions.answer: It resembles a living book spread across the cosmos that points to its Majestic Maker.

questions.question: What makes Life stand out from the other attributes in this section?
questions.answer: The passage says many different proofs gather around it, making its evidence especially abundant.

questions.question: How do living creatures help prove the attribute of Life?
questions.answer: Their existence and qualities reflect many signs that point to the One who is ever-living.

questions.question: What does the passage say Life does to the universe?
questions.answer: It keeps renewing and changing it so fresh displays and patterns keep appearing.
